data.name: Chrysanthemum: On the Way to Sweet Dreams
data.detailed_description:
SOLVE THE ISLAND’S DARK SECRETS

You find yourself at a secluded school on Libertas Island, a place built exclusively for anomalies؜ — humans with extraordinary abilities.

Beside the school lies a research center, where scientists study the students’ mysterious powers. Both the school and the center remain hidden from the outside world, ensuring dangerous anomalies don’t bring harm to anyone.

Yet the island itself - with its curses, plague-ridden lands and secretive cult harbors even greater dangers.

Throughout the novel, you’ll get to explore the entirety of Libertas and uncover its complicated history.

CHARACTERS

JI — The Main Character

“What’s wrong with being perfect? People are just jealous because they have nothing to criticize.”
A dreamer. A romantic. Life on the island feels like a surreal dream to her, until a harsh discovery makes her question everything she knows. Ji must choose her friends and enemies, find her true love and break free from the bewitching island or stay there forever.


OLAN —  The Withdrawn Dreamer

“We are so powerless and fragile, we could disappear at any moment.”
He will always listen and accept you for who you are. If he likes you enough, he might even draw a portrait of you. He can tell stories for hours, but his shy gaze reveals his scars.


RAJ — The Unapproachable Tsundere

“Stay away from me.”
Rude, hot-headed and hard to predict. He always keeps his distance from people. Only Ji has a chance to reach him. After all, they were once best friends.


SHHH — The Master of Deception

“Everyone needs a little mystery.”
Girls often fall in love with him at first sight. A mysterious islander with a unique name, fluent in many languages, a master of many crafts. He doesn’t mind spending some time with you, but it comes with a great price.

NOBEL — The Reckless Daredevil

“Here we meet again, Princess. Could it be fate?”

An energetic guy, who’s always seeking trouble — and always finding it. With him, you never know what tomorrow will bring, sometimes, those adventures are anything but fun.

SENSEI — Polite Perfection or…

“Please, take care. I won’t always be around“.

The chemistry teacher. He always knows how to cheer up his students and offer the right advice. Yet no one has ever uncovered his struggles or fears. It might be for the best.

ZOYA — A Loyal Friend

“I should be the one thanking you. Thanks, Ji. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.”

Ji’s only friend. She is so caring and loyal, willing to do anything for her. She hates deceit and betrayal, yet is hiding a fatal secret of her own. One that could ruin her entire friendship with Ji.

ABOUT THE GAME & ROUTE SYSTEM

Playtime (full version): 30–50h
Playtime (demo version): 2–4h

The amount of routes: 6 + 1 additional route

In development: Olan’s Route (1 out of 6 routes)


*Released in a route-by-route format.

The novel features 6 in-game days. The demo version is the first day that introduces all romanceable characters. Starting from the second day, you’ll have a chance to pursue a route with one of the male leads.

Each day offers an opportunity to pursue a character’s route. Be careful with your choices, the affection system does not guarantee success. We’re going to provide a guide for those who just want to reach their preferred endings.

data.short_description: A high school senior with superpowers longs to confess her feelings to her chemistry teacher, but the island’s mysterious anomalies turn her world upside down. A non-linear otome visual novel filled with sinister mysteries and complicated choices.
